command_template: fifan-maintain joint-preview --project PROJECT --profile DIRECTORY_PROFILE_JSON --file-plan ORIGINAL_FILE_PLAN_JSON --request ARCHIVE_REQUEST_JSON --archive-root AUTHORIZED_ARCHIVE_ROOT --records-dir AUTHORIZED_RECORDS_ROOT --output EXTERNAL_JOINT_REPORT_JSON
input_contract: An existing fingerprint-bound native file plan changing explicitly declared reference files, plus an explicit directory archive request and runtime-authorized external roots.
interpretation: Preview means final scoped navigation can be projected; it is not a native archive plan or permission to apply.
execution_order: Validate the unchanged candidate and original inputs.
Apply the original file plan with native file apply and retain its journal.
Create and review a fresh native directory archive-preview against the actual post-file state.
Apply that fresh native archive plan and retain its own journal.
recovery_order: Resume failed native operation using its real journal. To roll back a completed archive, restore the archive first, then recover the file journal. Never pass the joint projection to native directory apply.
